sesotho_text: Nka pilisi e le ngoe ka maho a robeli ka matsatsi a mararo.

english_text: Take one capsule three times daily for seven days.
sesotho_text: Nka capsule e le ngoe habeli ka letsatsi ka matsatsi a supileng.

english_text: Swallow the tablet whole with a full glass of water.
sesotho_text: Metsa pilisi ka botlalo le mohope o tletseng oa metsi.

english_text: Do not crush or chew this tablet; swallow it whole.
sesotho_text: U se ke ua hlohlela kapa ua hlafuna pilisi ena; e metse ka botlalo.

english_text: Place the tablet under your tongue and let it dissolve.
sesotho_text: Beha pilisi tlase ho leleme la hau mme u e lumelle ho nyamela.

english_text: Apply the cream thinly to the affected area twice daily.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa cream butle sebakeng se angoa habeli ka letsatsi.

english_text: Insert the suppository gently into the rectum.
sesotho_text: Kenya suppository butle ka hare ho rectum.

english_text: Inhale one puff from the inhaler and hold your breath for ten seconds.
sesotho_text: Hema phelo e le ngoe ho tsoa ho inhaler mme u tšoare moya oa hau ka metsotso e leshome.

english_text: Inject the solution subcutaneously into the abdomen or thigh.
sesotho_text: Kenya setšoelo ka tlase ho letlalo mpeng kapa serope.

english_text: Administer the injection into the upper outer quadrant of the buttock.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente karolo ea holimo ea kantle ea letheka.

english_text: Apply the patch to clean, dry, hairless skin on the upper arm.
sesotho_text: Beha patch letlalong le hloekileng, le omileng, le se nang moriri lephakeng le holimo.

english_text: Place the drops directly into the affected ear.
sesotho_text: Beha litšoelelo ka kotloloho tsebeng e angoa.

english_text: Instil two drops into each eye four times daily.
sesotho_text: Kenya litšoelelo tse peli leihlong le leng le le leng habeli ka letsatsi.

english_text: Apply the gel to the affected joint and rub in gently.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa gel maqhoeng a angoa mme u phehe butle.

english_text: Dissolve the tablet in a glass of water before drinking.
sesotho_text: Nyamesa pilisi mohopeng oa metsi pele ho noa.

english_text: Shake the suspension well before measuring the dose.
sesotho_text: Nyenyetsa suspension hantle pele ho lekola dose.

english_text: Use the measuring spoon provided to ensure the correct dose.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa sekhoro sa ho lekola se fanoeng ho netefatsa dose e nepahetseng.

english_text: Administer the injection slowly into the muscle.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente butle ka hare ho mochine.

english_text: Apply the ointment to the affected skin area and cover with a dressing.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa ointment sebakeng sa letlalo se angoa mme u koahele ka dressing.

english_text: Inhale the powder deeply into the lungs using the inhaler device.
sesotho_text: Hema phutholoho ka botebo matšoafong o sebelisa sesebelisoa sa inhaler.

english_text: Place the lozenge in the mouth and let it dissolve slowly.
sesotho_text: Beha lozenge molomong mme u e lumelle ho nyamela butle.

english_text: Administer the nasal spray by inserting the tip into one nostril.
sesotho_text: Fana ka nasal spray ka ho kenya ntlha sefubeng se le seng sa nko.

english_text: Apply the eye drops by pulling down the lower eyelid to form a pocket.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa litšoelelo tsa leihlo ka ho hohela tlase sefahleho sa tlase sa leihlo ho theha saka.

english_text: Inject the insulin subcutaneously and rotate injection sites regularly.
sesotho_text: Kenya insulin ka tlase ho letlalo mme u potolohe libaka tsa ho kenya ka mehla.

english_text: Administer the intravenous infusion over sixty minutes.
sesotho_text: Fana ka infusion ea madi ka hare ho metsotso e mashome a tšeletseng.

english_text: Apply the transdermal patch and replace it every seventy-two hours.
sesotho_text: Beha transdermal patch mme u e ntshe ka maho a mashome a supileng le metso e meli.

english_text: Dissolve the powder in 200ml of water and drink immediately.
sesotho_text: Nyamesa phutholoho ho 200ml ea metsi mme u noe hang hang.

english_text: Insert the vaginal tablet as high as possible using the applicator provided.
sesotho_text: Kenya pilisi ea vaginal ho phahama kamoo ho khonehang ka ho sebelisa applicator e fanoeng.

english_text: Administer the nebulised solution using a mask or mouthpiece.
sesotho_text: Fana ka setšoelo sa nebulised ka ho sebelisa mask kapa mouthpiece.

english_text: Apply the lotion to the scalp and leave for ten minutes before rinsing.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa lotion hloohong mme u e siee ka metsotso e leshome pele ho hlatsoa.

english_text: Swallow the capsule whole; do not open or chew it.
sesotho_text: Metsa capsule ka botlalo; u se ke ua e bula kapa ua e hlafuna.

english_text: Administer the injection at a ninety-degree angle for intramuscular injection.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente ka konokono ea masome a robong bakeng sa ente ea ka hare ho mochine.

english_text: Apply the cream to the skin and avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa cream letlalong mme u hane ho kopana le mahlo le li-mucous membrane.

english_text: Use the oral syringe to measure the correct dose for children.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa syringe ea molomo ho lekola dose e nepahetseng bakeng sa bana.

english_text: Administer the eye ointment along the inner lower eyelid.
sesotho_text: Fana ka eye ointment ka hare ho sefahleho sa tlase sa leihlo.

english_text: Place the sublingual film under the tongue and allow it to dissolve.
sesotho_text: Beha sublingual film tlase ho leleme mme u e lumelle ho nyamela.

english_text: Inject the solution at a forty-five-degree angle for subcutaneous injection.
sesotho_text: Kenya setšoelo ka konokono ea mashome a mane le metso e mehlano bakeng sa ente ea ka tlase ho letlalo.

english_text: Apply the spray to the affected area from a distance of fifteen centimetres.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa spray sebakeng se angoa ho tsoa sebakeng sa lisenitimetara tse leshome le metso e mehlano.

english_text: Administer the rectal enema by lying on your left side.
sesotho_text: Fana ka rectal enema ka ho robala lehlakoreng la hau la molema.

english_text: Inhale slowly and deeply when using the pressurised metered-dose inhaler.
sesotho_text: Hema butle le ka botebo ha u sebelisa pressurised metered-dose inhaler.

english_text: Apply the medicated shampoo to wet hair and leave for five minutes.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa shampoo ea moriana moriring o metsi mme u e siee ka metsotso e mehlano.

english_text: Administer the injection into the deltoid muscle of the upper arm.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente mochineng oa deltoid oa lephaka le holimo.

english_text: Place the effervescent tablet in water and wait until fully dissolved.
sesotho_text: Beha pilisi ea effervescent metsin mme u eme ho fihlela e nyamela ka botlalo.

english_text: Apply the topical solution using the applicator provided.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa setšoelo sa letlalo ka ho sebelisa applicator e fanoeng.

english_text: Administer the intramuscular injection into the vastus lateralis in infants.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente ea ka hare ho mochine ka hare ho vastus lateralis ho bana ba banyenyane.

english_text: Inhale through the mouthpiece of the dry powder inhaler in one steady breath.
sesotho_text: Hema ka mouthpiece ea dry powder inhaler ka moya o le mong o tsitsitseng.

english_text: Apply the nasal ointment inside each nostril using a cotton swab.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa nasal ointment ka hare ho sefuba se seng le se seng sa nko ka ho sebelisa cotton swab.

english_text: Administer the subcutaneous injection by pinching the skin before inserting the needle.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente ea ka tlase ho letlalo ka ho kama letlalo pele ho kenya inaliti.

english_text: Apply the medicated patch to the chest or back, not over broken skin.
sesotho_text: Beha patch ea moriana sefubeng kapa mokokotlong, eseng holim'a letlalo le senyehileng.

english_text: Instil the ear drops by tilting the head to one side and pulling the ear upward.
sesotho_text: Kenya litšoelelo tsa tsebe ka ho kekela hlooho lehlakoreng le le leng mme u hohele tsebe holimo.

english_text: Administer the oral rehydration solution in small sips over several hours.
sesotho_text: Fana ka setšoelo sa ho noa sa ho busa metsi ka meno a manyenyane ka maho a mang.

english_text: Apply the antifungal cream between the toes and to the surrounding skin.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa cream ea antifungal lipakeng tsa menwana ea maoto le letlalong le potileng.

english_text: Administer the injection using a pre-filled syringe as instructed.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente ka ho sebelisa syringe e tletseng pele joalo ka ha ho laetsoe.

english_text: Inhale the bronchodilator before the corticosteroid inhaler.
sesotho_text: Hema bronchodilator pele ho inhaler ea corticosteroid.

english_text: Apply the wound gel directly to the wound bed before covering.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa wound gel ka kotloloho sebakeng sa ntoa pele ho koahela.

english_text: Administer the intravitreal injection only by a trained ophthalmologist.
sesotho_text: Fana ka ente ea intravitreal ke ngaka ea mahlo e koetlisitsoeng feela.

english_text: Place the buccal tablet between the cheek and gum and allow it to dissolve.
sesotho_text: Beha pilisi ea buccal lipakeng tsa lerama le seno mme u e lumelle ho nyamela.

english_text: Administer the intravenous bolus slowly over two minutes.
sesotho_text: Fana ka intravenous bolus butle ka hare ho metsotso e mebeli.
